content.short: Drivers with a Bee dashcam earn HONEY on Hivemapper by capturing street-level imagery for a fresh, decentralized map.
content.description: Hivemapper builds a fresher map of the world by paying ordinary drivers to collect it. Contributors mount a Bee dashcam, drive as usual, and earn HONEY tokens on Solana for the imagery they capture. The network has already covered a large share of the world's roads. Businesses license the resulting map data through Bee Maps, with Lyft among the customers. Contributors earn more for usable, clear imagery of roads the map still needs, and the network is governed through a series of Hivemapper Improvement Proposals. Its live coverage map tracks cities from Tokyo to Paris to New York.
content.meta: Drive with a Bee dashcam, map streets and earn HONEY on Solana's decentralized mapping network. Explore Hivemapper on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
